recommendation.title: Best match: Quince · $80
recommendation.text: Black cotton twill, shirt collar and subtle side pockets. Closest verified option to your clean-front brief.
recommendation.test: Two options below, not four. Neither is corduroy or verified entirely natural-fiber; lining and trim caveats are explicit.

sources.title: View Quince · Black Harrington
sources.note: Black S/M selectable; M independently rechecked. Shell 100% organic cotton. Fully lined cotton-blend chambray with no fiber percentages. Elasticated cuffs/hem and leather pull. Thread/zip tape unspecified.

sources.title: View Bronson · Brown Moleskin Bomber
sources.note: Brown S/M available in live variant data at $150.99. 450 gsm cotton shell; 200 gsm cotton/lyocell lining. Lyocell is regenerated cellulose, not a natural fiber under a strict definition. Acrylic ribbing is synthetic. Merchant recommends sizing up; S/M labels do not establish US fit.

sources.title: Bronson · Brown Moleskin Bomber · delivery
sources.note: US delivery supported by shipping/returns policies; advertised free shipping above $99, not ZIP-verified; general standard estimate 9-14 working days or US warehouse 5-7 days, dispatch origin unknown; tax/import fees unknown

sources.note: 30 days; original unworn condition, tags and packaging; provided return label $7 for 1-2 items, exchange/store credit advertised free; original shipping/taxes/duties nonrefundable

evidenceNote: Exact retailer pages, S/M availability and official product photos checked October 14. Quince delivery was checked using ZIP 10016; the retailer estimated October 18, not a guaranteed arrival. Bronson destination checkout and tax were not verified. ARKET’s reference page blocked direct viewing; its indexed description identifies a straight-cut corduroy overshirt with chest patch pockets. These alternatives avoid prominent chest pockets but do not reproduce its corduroy texture.
caveat: 100% natural outer fabric is not the same as an entirely natural or plastic-free garment. Organic cotton does not establish a health benefit or absence of dyes/finishes. No exact-product influencer endorsement or independently verified safety certification is claimed.
